sites.name: Tam Chuc National Tourism Area
sites.event: Known as 'Ha Long Bay on land', home to the world's largest pagoda and host of the United Nations Day of Vesak.

sites.name: Ba Danh Pagoda
sites.event: An ancient pagoda famous for the idiom 'As deserted as Ba Danh Pagoda', located by the poetic Day River.

sites.name: Tran Thuong Temple
sites.event: A Special National Relic, reputedly an important food storage site of Hung Dao Dai Vuong Tran Quoc Tuan during the resistance war against the Mongol invaders.

sites.name: Ba Kien's House (Vu Dai Village)
sites.event: A house over 100 years old, the prototype in the classic literary work 'Chi Pheo' by writer Nam Cao.

sites.name: Long Doi Son Pagoda (Doi Pagoda)
sites.event: A Special National Relic, home to the Sung Thien Dien Linh Stele (a National Treasure) from the Ly Dynasty and the venue for the annual Doi Son Tich Dien (Ploughing) Festival.

sites.name: Dia Tang Phi Lai Tu (Dung Pagoda)
sites.event: A pagoda with beautiful, peaceful architecture leaning against the mountain, which has recently become a famous spiritual and 'Instagrammable' destination.

sites.name: Kem Trong
sites.event: A national scenic spot dubbed the 'Third finest cave of the Southern sky', which was once featured in the poetry of female poet Ho Xuan Huong.

sites.name: Lanh Giang Temple
sites.event: A place of worship for the Three Famous Deities of the Tran Dynasty, closely associated with Mother Goddess worship and the legends of the Red River.

sites.name: Bat Canh Son
sites.event: A scenic complex with 8 beautiful pagodas and caves, once a place where Lord Trinh Sam came to sightsee and compared to a carefree paradise.

sites.name: Doi Tam Drum Making Village
sites.event: A famous traditional drum-making village over 1,000 years old, where the largest thunder drum in Vietnam was made.

sites.name: Ao Dong - Luon Cave
sites.event: An eco-tourism area with picturesque landscapes of mountains and water, suitable for boating and cave exploration activities.
